title: gate の判定
description: role-settings.yaml の gate.output（json_schema）を Codex の --output-schema に写したもの。 Structured Outputs の制約により、properties の全キーが required に入る（任意項目は null を許す）。

why.description: 何を天秤にかけ、何が決め手になったか。verdict の言い換えは不可

evidence.description: 実際に走らせたコマンドと、その実出力（失敗も含む）。admit には必須

standard.description: 適用した基準（SPEC の MUST / seam contract / 機械バー）

alternatives.description: 採らなかった選択肢と、その理由

risk.description: 承知の上で残す穴。無いなら「無い」と明示

out_of_scope.description: MUST の範囲外で見つけた欠陥。reject の根拠にせず「Issue 化を推奨」として返す

findings.description: Each finding, separately. The id is what a response and the next round point at, so a finding that is not listed here cannot be answered or tracked — put every blocking observation in, not a prose summary of them.

id.description: Stable within this Issue, e.g. GATE-001. A response cites it.

claim.description: What is wrong, specifically enough to be checked by someone else.

evidence.description: The command and output, or the file and line, that establishes it.

blocks_admission.description: Whether this alone withholds the verdict. False means it was worth saying but is not why the work is held.

prior_finding.description: The id of the earlier finding this re-raises, or null if new. Re-raising one unchanged does not warrant another round — state what changed.
